title: Wall note
body:
# Wall Note ![wn](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6afdf9a6b8a1b97183389f3ef0dffc45454fa574_0.webp)

A Minecraft Fabric mod that adds placeable wall notes with image support. Enter a URL, place it on any surface, and display images in your world.

## Features

- **Placeable Wall Notes** — place notes on any block face: walls, floor, ceiling
- **Image Display** — paste an image URL and the note will render it in-world
- **4 Visual Variants** — each note randomly picks one of four paper textures
- **Copy System** — craft a signed note with paper to create copies (original is returned)
- **In-Game GUI** — intuitive screens for entering URLs, previewing images, and signing

## Items & Blocks

| Item / Block | Description |
|---|---|
| Wall Note | Blank note item |
| Written Wall Note | Signed note |
| Wall Note (block) | The placed block displaying the image |

## Crafting

![craft](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3c603b2938bb5e38b46afc3e2ee72e800e2424c.png)

![copy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fe3fdacb727e2a0f55cdbaec6108b113b1c4dccb_0.webp)

## Usage

1. **Craft** a Wall Note
2. **Right-click** while holding it to open the GUI
3. **Enter an image URL**
4. Click **Done** to preview the image
6. **Shift + right click** on the air to open the note preview.
5. **Right-click** on a block to place the note on its surface
6. **Right-click** the placed note to view the image

![okak](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e10610c811b8846ad7a601b74c717482bf95326a_0.webp)

![funny image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/399ece18b52f8afada29d4b789dc40332e768fa6_0.webp)

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.11**
- Fabric Loader **≥0.18.5**
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Super GUI Lib](https://modrinth.com/mod/sgl)
